notes.title: Backrooms: Exploration Store Page Is Now Live
notes.content:
The store page for Backrooms: Exploration is now officially live!
This game will be published this year, hopefully before summer. That's the plan for now,

[b]Go wishlist the game now![/b]

[h1][b]What happened to Backrooms: Found Footage 2?[/b][/h1]

- This is still the same game as Backrooms: Found Footage 2, but with a different name. It isn't really a sequel to the previous one, so it wouldn't have made any sense. Plus, I think this name is even better!

- This game is going to be a lot bigger than the previous one, making it much better. The actual gameplay is super realistic and smooth. Trust me, it will blow your mind. I will upload a trailer as soon as possible!

HNStudios

notes.title: Backrooms: Found Footage 2 - Announcement
notes.content:
I'm thrilled to announce my next game, [b]Backrooms: Found Footage 2[/b]! It is a sequel to the first one where things are getting even more exciting. This game will be much longer and more realistic than the first one. The game is in early development and it will not be released any time soon, but it's worth the wait. It will be a paid game, unlike the first one, though the price tag will stay under 10 dollars.

The game does not follow the happenings of the first game, it will have its own story. It takes place in the modern world, which is going to make the graphics even more realistic. That's all I can say about it for now. Here's some artwork that I made for this sequel:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45204871/550d89af5a088cc9da84f06bbfb979d73375f1fd.png[/img]

Will you ever update the first game?
- Yes, I have some plans for the first game as well. There are some things that need to be fixed, though I will not make the game itself longer. I will focus on the sequel for now.

HN Studios
